messages:
Samira: heads up — planning a 'sunset' infra deploy tonight 22:00 UTC. This touches routing and canary traffic split. Freeze window 21:45–23:15. Expect transient 503s for <1m during router restart. Assigning watchers + rollback owner. Details below.

Kai: I can be primary watcher 22:00–23:00. Will run smoke checks and monitor p95 latency.

Jesse: I'll be on rollback if needed. What's the rollback command?

Samira: rollback is a roll-forward to v1.12 or revert traffic via the router. Quick commands:

```
# scale old canary back up
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/router --to-revision=2021
# or revert config
curl -X POST https://infra-admin/internal/route -d '{"route":"stable"}'
```

Priya: I'll take post-deploy smoke (queries + embedding service). Link to smoke checklist: https://confluence.redwood/smoke/sunset-deploy

oncall-bot: Scheduled window created: 2025-07-19T22:00:00Z — reminders at 21:45 and 22:05.

Marco: small note — there's an ongoing DB migration in staging that may make schema checks noisy; avoid running schema-only alerts for 30m.

Jesse: noted. I'll disable the schema alert rule for the window.

Kai: Can someone add me to the rollout watchers in PagerDuty? I can't see the entry.

Samira: Added Kai + Priya to the rotation. Ping me if you don't get the alert.

Priya: quick check — are we using canary-split 5%->100% over 10m?

Samira: yes, plan is 5% initial, wait 5m, then 25%, wait 10m, then 100%. Manual pause at each step.

Kai: I'll watch the latency dash: /dash/infra/route-latency

Jesse: if rollback needed, I'll open the runbook: https://playbooks/redwood/rollback-router and call :phone: in this thread.

Marco: FYI I'll be offline after 22:30 but reachable by SMS.

Samira: Thanks — if anyone sees p95 > 800ms or error spike > 2% at any step call rollback. Otherwise we proceed. :thumbsup:

Priya: ACK.

oncall-bot: Reminder sent to watchers at 21:45.
